text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #23313d

g.text: An ideal Brayton gas cycle connects compression, heating, expansion, and cooling

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Ideal air-standard cycle: compressor/turbine isentropic, heater/cooler constant pressure. Heater represents combustor heat addition; cooler closes the model. A real
open gas turbine exhausts/replaces air and can have pressure losses.
